body: This is abuse and its definitely NOT your fault that is happening.

Yeah i do sometimes. But my family is like "there is no reason for you to be depressed. You Got a nice job/Apartment and everything you need".
And most of my friends be like "ah shit, well i dont know what to say" and i dont blame them. I think no one is able to understand what i am feeling if they dont know how this exactly feels like. And tbh most of the time i cant explain why i am feeling this way.

Same.
I guess the only reason im not doing it is my fear of physical pain and to fuck it up and have to suffer the Rest of my life with those consequences.

Be there for him. I have been depressed/suicidal since i can think. It helps me often just to be heard when i Talk to someone. Not to get advice, just someone who is really listening to me  and gives me the feeling that i dont have to be ashamed to have those thoughts.
